description: Category page (books.toscrape template) with 20 article.product_pod cards inside ol.row, a 50-link category nav, a pager, and a 'Recently viewed' sidebar of 3 cards built from the same product_pod component.

books.title: string — full book title
books.inStock: boolean — true when the card says In stock
books.url: url — absolute link to the book's page

notes: Long titles are truncated in the link text ('The Murder of Roger ...'); the full title is in a[title] and img[alt], and gold uses the full title. Links are relative ('../../../sharp-objects_997/index.html') and must resolve against the page URL to https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/<slug>/index.html. Ratings exist only as classes 'star-rating One'..'Five'. Two cards are 'Out of stock' (inStock false). The 3 'Recently viewed' sidebar cards (Tipping the Velvet, Soumission, The Requiem Red) reuse the product_pod markup but are not part of the listing. Page 1 of 2: only these 20 records are on this snapshot.
